text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin's advance, suggesting selective strength in both the largest assets. The Fear & Greed index at 25 indicates extreme fear despite the price moves, reflecting persistent skepticism even as buyers step in on dips. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 56.7% paired with moderate volume of $56B signals a consolidation phase where investors are rotating toward the safest major asset rather than building broad conviction.
